claims.text: Refractory materials have high melting temperatures.
A machine-learning model can predict the melting temperature of refractory materials.
A machine-learning model can predict the entropy of fusion of refractory materials.
A machine-learning model can predict the enthalpy of fusion of refractory materials.
A machine-learning model can predict the volume change of refractory materials at the melting point.
Configurational entropy mediates the relationship between applying the machine-learning model and predicting melting properties.
The machine-learning model learns a relationship between material composition and melting properties.
Learning the composition–melting-property relationship permits accurate predictions.
The proposed machine-learning model can accurately predict all four specified melting properties of refractory materials.
Ab initio free-energy methods based on density functional theory are computationally expensive.
Ab initio free-energy methods may be infeasible for high-throughput calculations.
Machine-learning prediction accuracy depends on the quality and quantity of training data.
Machine-learning prediction accuracy depends on the complexity of the material composition and structure.
Predictions may be especially uncertain for materials with complex compositions or structures.
Comparison against experimental melting-property measurements can test the proposed model.
